title: DJ Turn Me Up

location.name: The House (Club / DJ Booth: Midnight Booth), Atlantis
location.kind: packed house party in a city townhouse, with a bar, a DJ booth and an open-mic spot
location.real_analog: a converted casona in Roma Norte / Juarez, Mexico City, used for house parties with a back bar and turntables; restage of the Part 1 poetry-reading venue (POET at the bar)

situation: Inside the house he just entered, a DJ is dropped in and starts spinning and scratching. The POET, standing at the bar at the mic, gives a neo-soul performance of his love story to a full house party, with reaction shots and a crowd that answers him. The EX is only spoken about; the ghosts and the boxed-up house appear as projected or imagined images (inferred), never as the EX's face.
weather_light: interior: neon, strobe and spotlight, haze creeping across the floor lights, a dark cloud over the dance floor with a moonlit silver rim (spine); photo-realistic cyberpunk grade

set_pieces.name: DJ drops in
set_pieces.what_happens: Neon title over the booth; the DJ appears, spins, scratches; the fader slides and the crowd hushes waiting for the drop as the POET asks to be turned up.
set_pieces.camera: whip-pan to the booth, insert on the fader, wide of the hushed room
set_pieces.position: DJ booth against the back wall of the main room

set_pieces.name: Eyes wide shut at the mic
set_pieces.what_happens: POET at the bar, eyes closed, chin at the arch of the mic, opens his love story; strobe glints on his eyelids.
lines: chin nested at the arch of this mic
I have a love story to tell
set_pieces.camera: tight profile close-up at the mic, slow push; reverse onto faces in the crowd
set_pieces.position: the bar, side of the room facing the floor

set_pieces.name: Ghosts in the speaker mesh
set_pieces.what_happens: Transparent silhouettes drift through the speakers; vineyards and evergreen fields wilt in the projected light; treasures escape, stars on a marquee dim.
set_pieces.camera: macro on speaker mesh with superimposed silhouettes; cutaways to crowd watching
set_pieces.position: speaker stacks flanking the dance floor

set_pieces.name: A thousand light years, into the red
set_pieces.what_happens: He has walked across the greatest divide to be heard; on the second plea the VU meter slams into the red and the mic blooms.
set_pieces.camera: cut from galactic insert to VU meter close-up, then low angle on POET as the volume jumps
set_pieces.position: between the bar and the booth

set_pieces.name: Wedding bands and the boxed home
set_pieces.what_happens: Rings orbit and drift apart; the shared home folds into a box; two moving vans split at a fork on one-way streets with arrowless signs and a blank billboard.
set_pieces.camera: projected inserts on the wall behind the POET; crowd silhouettes in the foreground

set_pieces.name: Eleven years in daisy petals
set_pieces.what_happens: Calendar pages spin off the turntable for eleven beats; petals fall on the vinyl; the DJ scratches 'love, love, not, not'; the mic is held out to empty space.
lines: maybe we do love we not
set_pieces.camera: overhead on the platter, petals under the needle; cut to the empty space beside POET

set_pieces.name: Rain, fog, dim lights, then chin high
set_pieces.what_happens: The room picks its weather: storm waveform, fog across the floor lights, a dark cloud with a silver lining over the dancers. He turns to face delights and shadows, one night, tear and open mic at a time, chin now high, volume up.
lines: dimmed night lights under a cloud
one open mic at a time
set_pieces.camera: wide of the floor in haze with the cloud practical overhead; end on a low-angle close-up, POET's chin raised into the spotlight
set_pieces.position: dance floor under the Dark Cloud, ending at the mic

arrival.from_previous: Wandering Atlantis after the voiceover, he reaches a house people are entering and goes in; the DJ is then dropped into the house.

departure.to_next: He leaves the house party / poetry reading for an open-air rooftop club; the treatment does not say how he gets there (inferred: up the stairs to a nearby or same-building roof).

motifs: weather indoors (rain, fog, cloud with silver lining)
encoding: This is where the private breakup becomes a public performance: the house is Atlantis's social stage, and the DJ's volume is permission to be heard. It has to be a crowded room with a bar and a booth because the poem's journey is from eyes shut to chin high, from no one listening to one open mic at a time (the Part 1 reading restaged inside the fiction). Weather moves inside, so what he remembers about the breakup plays as the room's atmosphere (inferred).

open_questions: The spine stops at DJ070 ('at a time;'); no records cover 'one open mic at a time', 'chin now nested high' or 'a story to tell', and DJ020 is missing.
Is the rooftop club of Newly Single on top of this house or elsewhere in Atlantis?
Are the ghosts, vans and daisy petals projected in the room, imagined inserts, or the DJ's visuals? The treatment says only 'as described'.
The DJ 'is dropped into the house': literal drop (descends from above) or a hard cut?
Text variants: timings 'eyes wide shut... arc of the weight of these spoken words', 'eleven years... 11 years'; treatment 'arch of this mic'.
